name: TChess
tagline: Chess training app for Android and web. 1,000+ installs, 4.8 rating
description: Chess training app built with React Native, Expo and TypeScript, plus a Next.js web version. Runs Stockfish 17.1 on the device through a custom native module, with subscriptions across RevenueCat, Google Play Billing and Paddle.

fields.Problem: Chess players need a trainer that works offline, on a phone, with a real engine behind it, and a business model that survives reinstalls and clock tricks.
fields.What I Built: An Android app and web version with a hand-built board, 60,000 bundled puzzles, Stockfish 17.1 integrated through a custom NDK/JNI module, and subscriptions across RevenueCat, Google Play Billing and Paddle. Backend on Supabase with 11 Edge Functions and 48 Postgres migrations with row-level security.
fields.Result: 1,000+ Play installs, a 4.8 rating and 500+ monthly active devices. 1,500+ automated test cases across app and web, plus an engine check that replays all 60,000 bundled puzzles.

name: DareClock
tagline: Native Android alarm that only stops after a camera-verified exercise
description: Native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose alarm. It keeps ringing until you finish a mission, such as push-ups counted live with CameraX and on-device ML Kit pose detection. 7 releases in 3 weeks, 200 JUnit tests.

fields.Problem: Snooze buttons make alarms optional. Waking up needs a task that forces you out of bed.
fields.What I Built: A native app in Kotlin 2.2 and Jetpack Compose with CameraX and on-device ML Kit pose detection. Exact alarms, a foreground ringing service, boot recovery and an offline event queue, with Play Billing and RevenueCat.
fields.Result: Shipped 7 releases in 3 weeks, backed by 200 JUnit tests. Live on Google Play.

name: Brick Breaker: Power Rush
tagline: Unity arcade game on Google Play
description: Unity arcade brick breaker with ball volleys, ball upgrades, level missions, optional Google Play Games cloud save and a remove-ads purchase.

fields.What I Built: A Unity arcade game with ball volleys, ball upgrades and level missions, optional Google Play Games cloud save, and a remove-ads purchase.
fields.Result: Live on Google Play, published under Optivio Automation.

name: Chess Content Automation
tagline: Python pipeline that renders and publishes narrated chess reels
description: Pipeline built with Python, FFmpeg, Remotion and Playwright that renders and publishes narrated reels to Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and TikTok. 1,078 logged posts, 237 unit tests, Next.js control dashboard.

fields.Problem: Growing a chess app needs a steady stream of short video, and hand-editing it does not scale.
fields.What I Built: A pipeline with Python, FFmpeg, Remotion and Playwright that renders and publishes narrated reels on a schedule to Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and TikTok, with a Next.js control dashboard.
fields.Result: 1,078 published posts logged across 73 days, 480,000+ recorded plays and 237 unit tests.
